title: Loopmill Loop file
description: Schema for `.loopmill/<slug>.loop.yaml`. The Loop file is the source of truth for a Loopmill Loop: a bounded, versioned definition of an AI engineering loop that may span several vendors and several execution backends. See docs/spec/loop-file.md for the semantics this schema cannot express.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this Loop file format. MVP accepts 0.5.x.

slug.description: Immutable, user-visible Loop identity (`loopId`). Must equal the file's basename before `.loop.yaml`.

name.description: Human-readable title, shown in `loopmill runs`, the job summary and the read-only UI.

description.description: What the Loop is for. Free text; never sent to a runtime unless a prompt references it explicitly.

entry.description: Node the Run starts at. Optional: when omitted it is derived as the unique node with no incoming forward edge (LM-VAL-005).

repos.description: Repositories the Loop operates on. Exactly one in the MVP (LM-VAL-022).

nodes.description: Id-keyed map of Nodes. The map key IS the node id; `nodes.<id>....` references use that key.

edges.description: Retry Edges only. Forward edges are implied by `next` / `then` / `else`.

identifier.description: Lower-case kebab identifier, 2-64 characters, used for slugs, node ids and edge ids.

duration.description: ISO-8601 duration restricted to days, hours, minutes and seconds (no years, months or weeks: they are not a fixed number of seconds). Examples: PT30M, PT4H, P1DT12H.

inputName.description: Local name a node binds an input to. This is the name usable as `${name}` in templates and as the first path segment of a condition expression.

reference.description: Dotted reference to a value produced earlier in the Run.

scalar.description: A JSON scalar. Loopmill substitutes only scalars; arrays and objects are never templated.

effects.description: `external` marks a node that creates or changes something outside the Loop's working branch which a human or third party sees as the Loop's product (Issue, PR, release, deployment, message).

expression.description: Condition expression. Grammar in docs/spec/loop-file.md; operands are declared input names and JSON scalar literals.

trigger.description: How a Run starts. Discriminated by `kind`.

cron.description: Five-field cron expression (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week), evaluated in `tz`.

tz.description: IANA time zone name, or UTC.

source.description: MVP has one event source. Events are ingested by the `ingest` workflow and converted to Envelopes; a Loop is never started by an unmediated webhook.

items.description: GitHub event name, optionally narrowed by action: `issues.opened`, `pull_request.synchronize`.

repo.description: Exactly one of `path` or `remote` must be present.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the working tree. `.` means the repository the Loop file lives in.

remote.description: Clone URL, for a Loop that operates on a repository other than its own.

defaultBase.description: Branch new working branches are cut from and PRs target.

defaults.description: Values inherited by every node that does not set them. Node-level values always win; defaults never widen a node-level value.

budget.description: Bounds checked BEFORE each dispatch. A breach terminates the Run as BUDGET_EXCEEDED; a token budget never kills an attempt mid-flight.

maxAttempts.description: Infrastructure-level dispatches per Node Execution. Attempts > 1 exist only for LOST completions and transient backend errors, never for loop retries.

maxIterations.description: Loop-wide CAP on every Retry Edge's own `maxIterations`. The iteration budget itself is declared per Retry Edge; this field can only tighten it (LM-VAL-025).

maxRuntime.description: Wall clock per Run, excluding time spent in WAITING_HUMAN. Breach terminates the Run as EXPIRED.

maxMeasuredTokens.description: Per Run. Checked against measured tokens only (provenance `reported` or `derived`); `estimated` and `unavailable` never count towards it.

maxUnmeasuredExecutions.description: Per Run. Number of agent Node Executions whose usage provenance is `unavailable` that the Run may perform. This is the binding guard whenever usage coverage is below 100%.

maxRunsPerWindow.description: Per Loop. Default {count: 1, window: PT5H}, aligned with vendor rolling usage windows.

minInterval.description: Per Loop. Minimum wall-clock distance between the start of two Runs.

envPolicy.description: Environment policy for every subprocess Loopmill spawns. The built-in vendor-auth deny list and the built-in preserve list always apply; these fields only add to them.

deny.description: Additional variables scrubbed from every subprocess environment.

preserve.description: Additional variables passed through from the job environment. A name that also appears in the built-in deny list stays denied.

inject.description: Literal name/value pairs added to every subprocess environment. Values are literal strings; no templating, no secret references.

approval.description: Whether `effects: external` nodes require a human gate on every path.

reason.description: Required when policy is `auto`. Recorded in the Run header and shown in every report.

nodes.description: Optional narrowing: only these `effects: external` nodes are exempt from the gate requirement. Omitted means every external node is exempt.

inputs.description: Map of local name to a value produced earlier in the Run.

default.description: Used when `from` resolves to nothing. Without a default, an unresolvable reference is an error, never an empty string.

structuredOutputSchema.description: A JSON Schema describing the agent's final answer. Passed to `claude -p --json-schema` / `codex exec --output-schema`. This is a foreign schema document, so it is the one place where unknown keywords are allowed.

artifactMatcher.description: How Loopmill finds the result of a node that ran on a vendor's own cloud (`observed` backend). Loopmill emits the trigger and then polls for this artifact until the deadline.

kind.description: comment-fenced-block: a ```loopmill fenced JSON block in an Issue or PR comment. file-in-diff: a JSON file at `path` in the task's diff. pr-body: a ```loopmill fenced JSON block in the pull request body.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the JSON artifact. Required for `file-in-diff`, forbidden otherwise.

deadline.description: How long the Node Execution stays in OBSERVING before it becomes TIMED_OUT.

id.description: Optional echo of the map key. When present it must equal the key (LM-VAL-004).

model.description: Runtime-specific model id or alias. Passed through verbatim; Loopmill does not translate model names between vendors.

sessionPolicy.description: MVP supports `fresh` only: every Attempt is a new CLI process with no resumed session.

promptFile.description: Repository-relative path to the prompt. Its contents are templated exactly like an inline `prompt`.

argv.description: Executed with shell:false on the backend that owns the working tree. One `${name}` never splits into more than one argv element and is never re-parsed.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the repo root. Defaults to the repo root.

env.description: Allowlist: only these variables (intersected with the effective preserve+inject set) reach the command.

conditionNode.title: condition node
conditionNode.description: Runs on the control plane, not on a backend. A missing or non-conforming input is an error, never a silent false.

humanNode.title: human node
humanNode.description: Puts the Run into WAITING_HUMAN. Nothing is resident while it waits.

mode.description: environment-reviewers: a GitHub Environment with required reviewers gates the job before it starts. pull-request-review: an approving PR review. label: the `loopmill:hold` label is removed.

subject.description: The node execution whose artifact digest is being approved. A retry invalidates prior approvals because the digest changes.

outcome.description: Terminal label. Reported as SUCCEEDED(end:<label>). `success` and `no_change` are conventional; any label is allowed.

retryEdge.title: retry edge
retryEdge.description: The one kind of backward edge. Traversal increments cycleIndex; exhaustion is the terminal outcome MAX_ITERATIONS_EXCEEDED, never FAILED.

from.description: The node that routes into this edge via `next`, `then`, `else` or `onFailure: retry_edge:<id>`.

to.description: An earlier node. Must be on a forward path back to `from` (LM-VAL-008) and must run on a retryable backend (LM-VAL-007).

when.description: Optional assertion over the `from` node's declared inputs, evaluated at traversal. It does not route; it must be true when the edge is taken.

maxIterations.description: Maximum traversals of this edge in one Run. The body therefore executes at most maxIterations + 1 times.
